schema_updates: Keep old field keys, order and kinds. Append fields with valid migration defaults.
launching: Installed apps appear in the guest launcher with an icon; title and id are searchable.
storage: The launcher checkpoints confirmed schemas and rows to an explicit host file; no arbitrary file access.
numbers: Signed 32-bit integer cells; sums use signed 64-bit arithmetic. No decimal or currency conversion.

display_control.fields: Exactly one required number field with a valid default 20..100; no filter.
display_control.scope: QEMU software RGB attenuation only; no physical backlight or energy-saving claim.
display_control.execution: Explicit Apply checks the installed app capability. Install, update and restore do not actuate. Reset to 100% with F6.
display_control.storage: Control app schema persists; applied display level resets to 100% at boot.
display_control.updates: Capability is immutable; create a separate app for a different capability.

formulas.syntax: Integer literals, $key references, + - * /, unary minus and parentheses. References only to earlier number/calculated fields; no functions or loops.
formulas.semantics: Checked signed i32; division truncates toward zero. Missing input, overflow or zero division rejects the whole save/update. Required calculated fields have an empty default; ordinary fields have an empty formula.
formulas.updates: Keep editable values, recompute derived values. Validate every existing row before committing the schema update.

user_file_exchange.import: User-selected host exchange folder, inbox/<installed-app-id>.csv; guest previews then appends a validated batch only after confirmation. No model access to file paths or data.
user_file_exchange.export: Explicit user action exports all saved rows and computed values to a new outbox/<installed-app-id>-r<revision>.csv file; existing files are never overwritten.
user_file_exchange.limits: 1..8 incoming rows, existing per-app capacity still eight, exact input or full-field header, printable ASCII values up to 32 bytes. This adds no schema properties or model-callable file operations.
